name: Scallion Buns
description: loads of scallions on a soft milk bread bun with a bit of cheese
steps: Beat the egg and leave around 5g for egg wash at the end
Mix cold water, egg, yeast, salt, and sugar together well to ensure yeast and sugar are well combined
Add flour and mix until combined. Add oil and mix until combined.
Rest in fridge for 40 min, the dough should be elastic enough for a thick windowpane.
Do a couple of stretch and folds towards the center until the dough is smooth and tight
Let proof for 1 hour (until poke test result is no bounce back)
Make the scallion filling: oil, salt, and chopped scallions emacerated
Roll out the dough into 18 balls. (may need to add flour around the outside)
Rest in fridge for 20 minutes before creating the bread shape (either 3 balls for each braid, or a simple roll)
For braid: add eggwash, then the filling and a sprinkle of cheese right on top of the braid
For roll: add the filling in a sprinkle of cheese while rolling. Add eggwash and any leftover cheese and filling on top before baking
Proof the second time for 30 min (should pass the poke test and slowly bounce back)
notes: Dough is super sticky, but try not to add flour directly into the dough, use water/flour on a rolling pin and add flour to the outside
Even if the second proof does not pass poke test, it could still bake well as long as cold water was used
